In 2016, 3.8% of men and 2.6% of women aged ≥18 years currently used e-cigarettes.
A greater percentage of men aged 18–24 years and 25–49 years currently used e-cigarettes compared with women in the same age groups.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population

methods_quotes.q: With 95% confidence intervals indicated with error bars.
The denominator was adults aged ≥18 years.
